description:
Explicitly deferred. Do not implement in the V1 cutover. **Does not block** `sbdpi-vur`.

Named children exist so these are not forgotten and then smuggled into V1.

## Already childed

- Multi-epic `scopeIds` (array already in V1 goal record)
- Observe minions edit/write paths for advisory overlap
- Optional Beadwork TUI link to minion status (no live AgentTree import in V1)

## Also deferred (thin children)

- Compose-buffer-aware parent turn ordering
- Third-party/custom task-type registration
- Richer message threads or broadcast channels
- Live orchestration resumption after `/new` or process restart
- Historical orchestration analytics
- Automated ranking by dependency unlock value
- Remote or process-isolated minion backends

No implementation specs here. V1 remains process-local, one epic, advisory paths, packets + injected prompts.
